name: std::ranges::cartesian_product_view<First, Vs...>::size

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The number of elements, that is, the product of the sizes of all the underlying ranges.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: The return type is the smallest /*unsigned-integer-like*/ type that is sufficiently wide to store the product of the maximum sizes of all the underlying ranges, if such a type exists.

summary: Returns the number of elements. The return type is an implementation-defined /*unsigned-integer-like*/ type U.
